### Borea v0.6.4

A patch release that completes the Simplified Chinese translation again. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Simplified Chinese

- Simplified Chinese now covers every text in Borea again, including the messages about a game folder without KSA.dll and the suggestion of the right folder. Thanks to @kuxiaowo.

Full changelog: [v0.6.3...v0.6.4](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.3...v0.6.4)
